task.title: N264 — SELECT + derive the next node (theory-native FIRST; come up to speed, then choose and justify the target)
task.body:
THIS IS A SELECTION TICKET. Your FIRST job is NOT to execute a pre-decided target — there is none.
Your first job is to SELECT the next node by running docs/NODE_SELECTION.md (the SELECT protocol),
IN FULL, before anything else. Priority: (1) select the theory-native target ≫ (2) justify it and
rewrite this ticket ≫ (3) execute it. (1) is the whole point; do not shortcut it.

THE ONE RISK THAT MATTERS: setting up a target in standard-math / standard-physics terms instead of
the theory's own terms. Every wall this project has hit came from that. The theory reframes things
in subtle, profound ways — it turns standard walls into dissolved consequences. Your job is to find
what the theory ITSELF says comes next, run it through the ANTI-BULLSHIT GATE (S4), and refuse to
self-justify a standard-math step as theory-native. Do NOT bullshit at this decision point — lean in.

⚠ NO METHOD-LOCK IS IN FORCE (the 2026-06-30 gather-side lock was LIFTED 2026-07-03; docs/ROADMAP.md
§"METHOD-LOCK LIFTED", ~line 10580). BOTH the GATHER side (mining the gluing obstruction / associator
cocycle / its representation content) and the ASCENT side (the invariant-tower method — trace form /
cubic norm / Freudenthal / Peirce idempotents on J₃(𝕆); the un-parked N218 hypercharge-normalization
front) are OPEN. At S2/S4 you MUST consider BOTH directions explicitly and choose on the merits
(depth, theory-nativeness, novelty/ROI), recording the comparison in your SELECT reasoning — name
what each side offers for the target you weigh and why you picked the one you did. Neither is
privileged; neither is forbidden; the ONE LAW still applies (if the chosen method fights you, reframe
or switch side, don't grind). Legacy "(under the LOCK)/ascent FORBIDDEN" tags in older LANDED docs are
HISTORICAL, not current.

WHAT IS BANKED (the launch platform — neutral facts, no next-target decision):

N263 LANDED (commit 0a2edb2 code + 9165531 audit-import fix + 5180cd4 docs,
Phys/Algebra/TowerWorldMapVectorSpinorSo7.lean, 10 decls foundations-only [propext, Classical.choice,
Quot.sound]; costume C294 4=294; gate-fast D0-D6 GREEN): THE TWO FACES OF so(7) ARE ONE. The
"one so(7), two faces" that N262's docstring + CONSTELLATION ★1/★3 had ASSERTED in prose is now a
PROVED theorem: the gauge TEAR so(7) (`skewAdjointLieSubalgebra bornBil` on the VECTOR 7 `ImO`,
N225–N260, carrying the SM gauge structure) and the SPINOR-rotation so(7) (the spin generators
`spinGen` close into, on the 8-dim spinor `O ℚ`, N262) are ONE so(7) in its two natural
representations. KEY banked FACTS: `bornBil x y = gForm x y` (both so(7)'s defined by the SAME fold
Born form); `elemRot a b : Module.End ℚ ImO := c ↦ (gForm a c)•b − (gForm b c)•a` (the elementary
so(V) vector rotation generator), with `elemRot_skew` (`elemRot a b ∈ skewAdjointLieSubalgebra
bornBil` — the vector rotation lives in the BANKED gauge so(7)), `elemRot_antisymm`/`elemRot_self`;
`leftReg_injective` (the "gamma" frame `{L_c}` is a FAITHFUL copy of the vector 7 inside `End(O ℚ)`);
THE BRIDGE `spinGen_vector_action` (`spinGen a b * leftReg c − leftReg c * spinGen a b = leftReg
((4:ℚ) • elemRot a b c)` — the spinor spin generator's ad-action on the faithful frame IS `leftReg`
of that gauge-so(7) vector rotation, the "bivector ≅ so(V)" iso read off N262's `spinGen_act` with NO
external Clifford apparatus); `elemRot_bracket` (the vector face closes by the SAME so(V) structure
relation as `spinGen`, up to the Clifford scale 4); W8 `elemRot_frame_ne_zero`; capstone
`two_faces_of_so7`. THE DISSOLUTION: the field builds `so(V)` on V, SEPARATELY builds `Cl(V,q)`,
extracts the bivectors `Λ²V`, proves the EXTERNAL iso `Λ²V ≅ so(V)`, acts on the spinor — the theory
reads it off the ONE Born form `gForm` as `spinGen_act` composed with `leftReg`-injectivity. SCOPE:
banks the vector↔spinor so(7) identification AT THE ACTION LEVEL + `elemRot ∈` the banked gauge so(7)
+ same so(V) closure + faithfulness + non-vacuity ONLY; NOT a bundled cross-dimensional LieAlgebra
ISO object (spinor rep on the 8-dim `O ℚ` vs vector rep on the 7-dim `ImO`), NOT `Spin(7)`, NOT the
full `Cl(0,7)` algebra iso; the weak mixing angle untouched.

THE ARC (neutral): N219–N234 mined the gather obstruction and g₂-decomposed 7⊗7=1⊕7⊕14⊕27 (atoms
irreducible). N240–N260 derived the SM GAUGE structure (★1) as one object inside the gather tear
so(7)=14⊕7 (charge/hypercharge directions, both SM reductive factors, shared isospin Cartan, the tear
regenerating the ambient); ★1 at capstone. N261 turned to MATTER (★3): O ℚ is a spinor (Clifford
module). N262: the antisymmetric worldMap half is the spin generator, rotating the vectors as so(7)
and closing into so(7). N263: proved the gauge so(7) (on the vector 7) and the spinor so(7) (on the
spinor 8) are ONE so(7) in two representations — the ★1↔★3 seam joint.

STARS (neutral status): ★1 gauge group [at capstone]. ★2 electroweak mixing [partial — mixing angle
deferred ≥9× for a structural reason; the ASCENT invariant tower (J₃(O), N218 un-parked) is the
flagged instrument but a HEAVY route-finding subproject]. ★3 one generation of matter [partial —
Clebsch-Gordan closed (N234); N261 O as Clifford module/spinor; N262 the spin generators = so(7)
acting on the spinor; N263 that so(7) is the gauge so(7) in its two representations]. ★6 chirality
[partial — N44 chirality block].

DEFERRED / OPEN FRONTS (candidates SELECT must WEIGH against a fresh theory-native derivation, NOT
auto-pick): (A) the weak MIXING ANGLE / hypercharge NORMALIZATION — deferred ≥9× (the so(7) neutral
plane supplies no posit-free richer structure; Q∉span{T3,Y}, [Q,Y]≠0). The ASCENT invariant tower may
be the instrument, but it is a heavy route-finding subproject — weigh honestly under budget. (B) the
★3 matter arena forward from N263's two-faces identification: e.g. how the DERIVED SM gauge algebra
(N247/N258, subalgebras of the gauge so(7)) ACTS on the spinor O ℚ THROUGH the now-proved
representation link (does the derived colour/isospin/charge act on the 8-dim spinor via the vector
rep transported by leftReg?); the chirality grading of the spinor (the L_a swap odd/even, ★6 hook);
the exponentiated Spin(7) group; the full Cl(0,7) algebra + iso; the 8-dim O as a specific spinor rep.
(C) the FFT count dim End_{g₂}(7⊗7)=4 as a short Schur corollary of atomicity (N234 residual).

PROCEDURE:
  S1 come up to speed (docs + recent tickets + git log) — post the arc synthesis comment.
  S2 derive, from the GOAL lens and the REFRAMING lens, what the theory itself says comes next.
  S3 reconcile with the current arc — if they diverge, FOLLOW THE THEORY, redirect the target.
     ⚠ Weigh BOTH the gather and the ascent sides explicitly (lock lifted).
  S4 run the chosen target through the ANTI-BULLSHIT GATE (fold-causal / dissolution / goal-words-
     removable / name-the-temptation / honesty) — in writing, with specifics.
  S5 rewrite THIS ticket's title+body with the decided target in the standard node format, put the
     selection reasoning in the comment thread, THEN execute under full discipline (STEP 0-4).

RESUME-FIRST: prior runs of this ticket may have timed out mid-work. BEFORE deriving from scratch,
check git HEAD + `ps aux` + this task's current_run_id (kanban_show authoritative) + workbench/N264-
select/ for an existing PREREG + probes. If HEAD already commits code+costume+audit but docs/child/
complete are missing, that is W6 verify-then-finalize (re-audit the olean foundations-only, gate-fast
ONCE, wire docs, child, complete) — NOT a rebuild.

If SELECT concludes the honest next step needs a NEW AXIOM or an EXTERNAL/EMPIRICAL NUMBER, do not
invent it — kanban_comment "CHAIN RUNWAY: <which>" and complete (human-gated).

Next costume id: C295. max_retries=25, --max-runtime 90m, --workspace dir:/Users/elliotweaver/phys-lean, assignee phys-novelty.

comments.author: phys-novelty
comments.body:
SELECT S2 — THEORY-NATIVE NEXT BEAT (goal lens + reframing lens, arc set aside).

GOAL LENS (the fold's own story). The fold produces inner worlds; the worldMap is how a standpoint acts. N44 (a FOUNDATIONAL "one cause, many terminations" node) established the deepest fact about the worldMap: it has TWO faces — the LEFT action L_a=(a·) and the RIGHT action R_a=(·a) — and these two faces do NOT all commute, PROVED equivalent to non-associativity (chirality_commute_iff_assoc), the SAME single cause as the cascade-stop and the generation-cap. N261-263 then built the SPINOR entirely on the LEFT face (leftReg=L). But the fold's worldMap is intrinsically TWO-HANDED, and the theory's own foundational result says the two hands are irreducibly distinct. So the theory's next beat is NOT "prove another property of the left spinor" — it is to complete the object the fold actually makes: a spinor carrying BOTH chiralities, where the SAME octonionic non-associativity that made it a spinor at all (N261) now FORBIDS the two chiralities from fusing into one commuting action. This is the fold saying its spinor is intrinsically chiral — the structural germ of ★6 (chirality/parity), which today exists ONLY as N44's abstract algebraic block, DISCONNECTED from the derived spinor.

REFRAMING LENS (what the theory says that standard physics does not). Standard physics POSITS chirality: it puts left- and right-handed Weyl spinors in by hand as separate irreps of the (complexified) Clifford algebra, then imposes that the weak interaction couples only to one — parity violation is an EMPIRICAL input, not derived. THE THEORY INVERTS + DISSOLVES this: there is ONE worldMap with two multiplication faces; BOTH are Clifford modules for the same Born form (leftReg_clifford N261, and rightReg_clifford — de-risked THIS run, EXIT 0, the exact mirror via mul_mul_right); and the OBSTRUCTION to identifying them — to treating the spinor as carrying a single unambiguous handedness-blind action — is EXACTLY the octonionic non-associativity (the mixed commutator [L_a,R_b]x = a(xb)-(ax)b = -assoc(a,x,b), de-risked EXIT 0). The field's separate "there are two chiralities and they don't mix" becomes ONE forced consequence of the fold's own non-associativity: the two handednesses are the two worldMap faces, and they are irreducibly distinct because O does not associate. The wall the field posits (two chiralities as independent inputs) is the theory's derived block.

METHOD COMPARISON (lock lifted — weigh BOTH sides). GATHER side: this target is gather-native and needs NO new construction — it binds two BANKED objects: N261's left spinor (leftReg_clifford) and N44's right regular action (RightMul + the chirality_block), assembling the right Clifford module (de-risked) and lifting the block into the spinor framing. All levers already compile. ASCENT side: the invariant-tower ascent (J₃(O) Freudenthal) is the flagged instrument for the ≥9×-deferred mixing angle (★2) — but it is a HEAVY route-finding subproject, and THE ONE LAW warns against launching a big tower at a fought constant under budget. The ascent offers NOTHING for this joint: the two-chiralities structure is not a normalization/constant question, it is a representation-obstruction fact living entirely in the gather worldMap. VERDICT: GATHER side wins decisively — more forced (all objects banked, all cruxes EXIT 0 this run), more theory-native (it derives what the field posits: two chiralities), higher ROI (turns N44's abstract block into a spinor-level chirality germ and connects ★3↔★6), and it does NOT fight.

comments.author: phys-novelty
comments.body:
SELECT S3 — RECONCILE with the arc. The arc N261→262→263 points at "spinor structure" (★3). My S2 beat ALIGNS with ★3 but SHARPENS + REDIRECTS: instead of the saturated-adjacent temptations a N263-finisher reaches for (Spin(7) / import Cl(0,7) / characterize leftReg's image / gauge-action-on-spinor — all "next adjacent property" or heavy-import), the theory says the LIVE beat is to COMPLETE the object the fold actually makes (a two-handed worldMap) and prove the JOINT connecting the ★3 spinor arc to the ★6 chirality star through the one cause. N44's chirality_block predates the ENTIRE spinor construction and lives on raw O ℚ (LeftMul/RightMul on all of O), NOT on the ImO Clifford module — so "the derived spinor is intrinsically chiral" is nowhere banked. FOLLOW THE THEORY: select the joint.

SELECT S4 — THE ANTI-BULLSHIT GATE. Chosen target N264 = THE SPINOR IS INTRINSICALLY TWO-HANDED: the fold's worldMap has TWO chirality faces (left & right regular actions), BOTH Clifford modules for the ONE Born form gForm, and octonionic non-associativity FORBIDS fusing them into a single commuting action — the two-handedness germ of matter (★3↔★6), forced by the one cause.

1. FOLD-CAUSAL TEST (each arrow forced). Fold → self-blindness needs √−1 → Cayley–Dickson doubling → terminal O ℚ (cascade stops, non-assoc, N2c) → the fold's worldMap acts by multiplication, which on a non-commutative-then-non-associative algebra has TWO irreducibly-distinct faces L_a=(a·) and R_a=(·a) (N44) → the LEFT face is a Clifford module = spinor (N261, via left-alternativity mul_mul_left) → the RIGHT face is EQUALLY a Clifford module (rightReg_clifford, via right-alternativity mul_mul_right — the EXACT mirror law the cascade also keeps) → the obstruction to fusing the two faces (the mixed commutator [L_a,R_b]x = a(xb)−(ax)b) IS the associator (chir_mixed_apply), which is nonzero EXACTLY because O is non-associative. Every arrow forced; none routes through "the field's theory of X says do Y." The node is the fold's statement that the spinor it makes is intrinsically two-handed and the two hands cannot merge.

2. DISSOLUTION TEST. Standard-math/physics version: chirality is POSITED — left- and right-handed Weyl spinors are put in by hand as separate irreps, and parity violation (weak couples to one hand) is an EMPIRICAL input. THE THEORY DISSOLVES the posit of TWO-NESS + NON-FUSION: there is ONE worldMap with two multiplication faces; both are Clifford modules for the same fold Born form; and their non-fusion is not an axiom but the octonionic non-associativity ([L_a,R_b]=associator). The field's "there are two chiralities and they don't mix" collapses to one forced consequence of the cascade's own stop. GENUINE dissolution, named. ⚠ HONEST LIMIT: this dissolves the TWO-NESS + IRREDUCIBILITY of chirality; it does NOT derive parity violation (WHICH hand the weak force couples to) — that stays a separate, harder, downstream node. Scoped accordingly.

3. GOAL-WORDS-REMOVABLE TEST. Delete "chirality/handedness/spinor/Weyl/parity/matter": the pure statement is "the right-regular action rightReg of the derived non-associative O ℚ, restricted to ImO, is ALSO a Clifford module for gForm (rightReg_clifford, mirror of N261); the mixed commutator of the left and right regular actions equals the associator middle-slot (chir_mixed_apply); the two actions do NOT all commute on the imaginary generators (chir_spinor_block, with a concrete imaginary witness chir_spinor_block_witness), equivalently O is non-associative — the same banked not_associative that stops the cascade." A complete mathematical reason survives with NO physics word, and it is ABOUT the banked tower objects (leftReg/rightReg/gForm/ImO/O ℚ), not carrier-agnostic. PASS.

4. NAME THE STANDARD-MATH TEMPTATION. Two temptations, both refused: (a) the saturated N263-adjacent set (Spin(7)/Cl(0,7)/image-characterization/gauge-on-spinor) — heavy imports or next-adjacent characterization, W4.5 gold-plating; (b) THE SNEAKY ONE most dangerous here: "just bank rightReg_clifford as the mirror lemma of N261." That alone WOULD be a QUIET-DRIFT mirror-bank (for ANY alternative algebra both regular actions are Clifford — words-removable-inverse would expose it as generic). MY TARGET IS DIFFERENT: rightReg_clifford is only a supporting INGREDIENT that makes "two chiralities" non-vacuous; the HEADLINE and capstone are the JOINT — the two faces are irreducibly non-fusable BY THE ONE CAUSE (non-associativity), connecting the freshly-built ★3 spinor to N44's ★6 block, which N44 (predating the spinor, on raw O) never did. The node's center of gravity is the connection, not the mirror.

5. HONESTY CLAUSE. Being honest: the risk is that this slides into "mirror lemma + N44 restated." I keep it genuine by CENTERING on the joint (chir_mixed_apply = the associator bridge; the one-cause link to not_associative/chirality_block_iff_jordan_cap; the capstone bundling BOTH faces as spinor structures + their forced non-fusion) and SCOPING honestly: banks (i) the right face as a second Clifford module, (ii) the mixed commutator = associator, (iii) the block on imaginary generators with a concrete imaginary witness, (iv) the one-cause link — i.e. the STRUCTURAL GERM of chirality (two irreducibly-distinct handednesses, forced), NOT parity violation, NOT a Z2 Weyl-grading of O into O±. All cruxes compiled EXIT 0 this run (key_sq_right, rightReg, rightReg_sq, rightReg_clifford, chir_mixed_apply, chir_commute_of_assoc, chir_spinor_block_witness — and both witness elements confirmed ∈ ImO). It is FORWARD (connects two arcs), de-risked, and about the banked objects. PASS — no bullshit; survives all five on the theory's own terms.

DECISION: SELECT N264 = THE SPINOR IS INTRINSICALLY TWO-HANDED. Proceed to S5 (commit target) then execute STEP 0-4.
